transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

I’ve been planning my days around avoiding elevators. I take five flights of stairs at home, turned down a workshop because it was in a high-rise, and I’ve stopped visiting one of my older computer students because his building doesn’t really have another option.
Do you feel this kind of fear or need to avoid any other situations, such as public transportation, open spaces, or crowded places?
No, I haven’t really noticed that with other places. It’s mainly elevators.
Have you ever had sudden, unexpected waves of intense fear or panic happen completely out of the blue, without any clear trigger?
No, I don’t think so. It’s not something that just comes out of nowhere for me.
How long have you been dealing with this fear of elevators?
About seven months now—since not long after I moved into my fifth-floor apartment and had that scare in the elevator.
